reviews.text:
An absolutely unacceptable experience.

I took my dog ​​there only for a bath and brushing. I never authorized them to cut his hair. Even so, they decided to do it without my consent.

They completely ruined the style he had been growing for months. Instead of respecting the client's instructions, they imposed their own aesthetic criteria, and the result is awful.

The worst part isn't just the bad haircut, but the total lack of respect for the animal's owner. No one should alter a pet's appearance without first asking permission.

I do not recommend this place under any circumstances. If you value your pets and want them to respect your wishes, find another groomer. Here, they do whatever they want, and then the client is the one who has to deal with the consequences.

I will never return, and I hope no one else has to go through such a disappointing experience.

Finally, I hope they close their doors for good soon and stop harassing their customers.
I'm delighted, the service is a 10 and the work is too.

Unfortunately, my experience was very disappointing.

The worst part was that we had only booked a bath, and without asking our permission, they decided to trim the hair around her face because, according to them, it was very patchy. This style was intentional, and even if they felt she needed a trim, any change to a pet's appearance should only be done with the owner's authorization.

Furthermore, during the drying process, I got the impression that they handled my dog ​​quite roughly. When I picked her up, she was very nervous and uncomfortable, so I preferred to leave without arguing because my priority was getting her out of there.

Finally, there was also a problem with the booking. I booked through the first website that appeared on Google with the same name as the groomer, and instead of explaining the situation to us politely, they spoke to us unprofessionally. As customers, we shouldn't have to verify whether that website is the official one or not.

We won't be back.

Excellent service!! I took my Maine Coon cats in and they were bathed and had all their dead fur removed in record time, and they were treated with so much care. They look gorgeous and are ready for summer! Definitely my go-to cat groomer.
Excellent treatment and attention from the Contigo Cuidados team for my cat Federico. We'll be back!

I took my dog ​​this morning. I picked him up, and he got so excited when he saw me waiting for me that the groomer let him go. But they didn't ask if anything needed fixing. I paid and left. I took him home and dropped him off. When I returned in the afternoon, I noticed that they had cut his face badly; one side was shorter and the other longer, which looks terrible. I'm very upset because it takes me an hour and a half to take him to El Corte Inglés at Nuevos Ministerios and back home. They also cut his face badly before, but it was the groomer. They should be more careful because the haircut isn't cheap, and I don't have much time. They should be more careful; they're professionals, after all, and they shouldn't rush and leave me with a bad haircut. The truth is that I always take two Maltese dogs with me, but the way they're treated makes me not want to make the effort...if they don't look good.
Excellent service, my Maltipoo looked beautiful. Dirce followed my instructions perfectly. Highly recommended. The best groomer in Madrid.
He's great with cats!

I took my two Siberian cats for a deshedding service and I couldn't be happier with the experience.

The service was excellent from the very first moment: the staff are lovely, very attentive, and you can tell they have genuine sensitivity and love for animals. They treated Maeve and Mira with great care and professionalism, which gave me complete peace of mind.

The result was fantastic; the quality of the service and the attention to detail are evident. We will definitely be back.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a reliable service for their pets.
Wonderful. The patience they have with my kitten is immense. They treat him with such care. I love it.
We took Freya for a deshedding and a calming and restorative bath! She looks beautiful! We'll be back.

The service was outstanding, and they made our furry friend look absolutely gorgeous. She left happy, giving kisses to the groomer, which I think is the best sign of the care and affection they give to the animals. We will definitely be back. Thank you so much!
We took our kitten in for a bath and deshedding treatment, and they treated her/us wonderfully. We'll definitely be back! ☺️
I took my long-haired corgi and they made her look spectacular ✨✨✨
My lucky one is thrilled with them, he always goes in super happy and comes out the same way, the service is super good and they make him look so handsome ❣️
Excellent experience at this dog grooming service… Both Teresa and Renzo do a great job and take very good care of the pets.
Excellent service 🤩 …

I took my two cats there. I've always been afraid of groomers because my cats are difficult, but Dirce and Tete gave me a lot of peace when treating my cats. I was pleasantly surprised; they were very professional and did a great job.
I always find everything I need for my kittens, and the service is excellent, especially from Renzo, who always treats us wonderfully!
Everything was perfect, thank you very much.
Excellent professionals. They were very careful with our little ones. They left them very clean and without any knots 🥰. We are delighted. Thank you so much. Momo and Hoshi …

The service was excellent... I don't go more often because the prices are high... you could come up with discount vouchers for 5 sessions or something so that getting your dog's hair cut doesn't cost more than going to the groomer yourself! 😂 …

Very satisfied with the service and the treatment. My dog, Ittai, is delighted; they are very kind and professional and always leave him looking his best. I absolutely recommend them. In my case, Renzo, who takes care of my dog, is a 10 out of 10; it couldn't be better. Thank you.
The best pet groomer, without a doubt, number one!

Wonderful place! I took my two Maltese dogs there on Saturday. Dirce and Teresa were lovely and very, very professional. Our dogs left looking gorgeous and happy! They clearly fell in love with Teresa; they didn't want to go home! We'll be back!

I found the perfect hair salon, I'm thrilled! It's the first time I've taken my baby there and they made him look beautiful.
Thank you so much, Renzo, you were very kind and attentive. We'll definitely be back. ☺️☺

I wanted to make another appointment because the place is very hygienic, but the abusive and rude brunette still works there, and so does Dirce, who also experienced it... I'm just waiting for them to be fired...
We took our two Maine Coon kittens, Ellie and Ciri, for the first time and they did a perfect job. They are very professional.
Awesome people! Awesome service!
Excellent service 😊 …

Incredible 🤩 They've made them look better than ever! It's the first time the dogs haven't been scared and they even wanted to stay put 🩵 If you're looking for a place where they'll be treated like family and made gorgeous, this is it!! …
Happy with the service and the treatment, Dirce and Teresa were very kind, Maja was very happy when I picked her up, we will definitely return for her next bath
The best hair salon I've found in Madrid. Mia looked gorgeous and was so happy when I went to pick her up. They treated her like royalty.
Delighted with the work they do

I took Zar this morning for the first time and it was a wonderful experience full of great professionalism and friendliness. I will definitely repeat the experience. Thank you very much from my dog ​​and me.

We took our two Siberian cats, Lily and Ludwig, and the experience was outstanding.
Dirce and Teresa are fantastic, both in their handling skills, their knowledge, and the love with which they treated them.
Their facilities are a 12 out of 10. Absolutely recommended.
We'll be back.

Hi everyone, I have a 12-year-old pug. As you know, they're a breed that sheds a lot, so I tried several places for his grooming, and since I found this one, I haven't gone anywhere else. They leave him silky smooth, perfectly combed, and beautifully groomed. They do a thorough job and treat him with love. Highly recommended! 🐶💖 …
Renzo was very professional and empathetic, and he's pleasant to work with. We'll continue bringing Marvel there, as it was a great choice to come to this wonderful place.

“I want to thank Dirce for the excellent work she always does with my dog. You can see the love, patience, and professionalism with which she treats the furry ones. Every time we leave the groomer, my freckled girl looks gorgeous and is so happy. Without a doubt, the whole team is the best, and thank Dirce for your trust! 🐶✂️💖” …
Thank you 😊 …
He told me to ask him where they were located, and he said behind my house. Not at my house, at my house.
We took our dog Charo for a haircut. She's anxious and it's hard to keep her calm, but the experience was great, both for her and for us, and she looked beautiful afterward. We'll be back!

Our gratitude to Helena and her team for their expertise and compassionate professionalism.

Caring for our friend Purpura, and making visible what the eye cannot perceive.

Dirce and Teresa are wonderful, very kind, and they treated Arturo, the little 4-month-old poodle, like royalty. They gave him a bath, trimmed his nails, and left him looking fantastic—super fluffy! The service was excellent. I'll definitely take him back so they can make him look as relaxed and handsome as he did this time.
Everyone was very professional, Nala and I are very happy

My cat Fufu wouldn't let anyone brush or cut her fur. But the special care and attention from Maria and her colleague made her let them, leaving her looking so beautiful and refreshed, and so happy! 🥰 The whole process was quick and professional, so we'll be back soon. Thank you so much! 🌹🥰 …
I've been coming here for many years. They're a truly fantastic team, and their treatment of the animals is impeccable. You can tell when someone enjoys their work. Seriously, highly recommended.
I took my two dogs, Cloe and Almendra, and they looked absolutely gorgeous. Tete and Dirce were incredibly professional and took great care. Congratulations!
I took my dog ​​Cher and Renzo did a great job! You can tell they love what they do and have a lot of experience with animals. I'll definitely be back. Highly recommended!

HORRID!!!! They treated me terribly, trying to make sure I wouldn't come back, and they confessed why. They confirmed that it was best if I never returned... Apparently, because I arrived about 30 minutes late on other days, they got tired of it... And I ask you???: Is that a reason to treat my dog ​​badly and me badly too? And on the second-to-last day, instead of telling me, "You arrived late and I can't see you," they told me I didn't have an appointment at that time...! When it was a lie! That's not right! If I arrive late, I'm not forcing you to see me, but if you do, I expect you to do it with kindness and respect! And don't reschedule for another day... Simple, whether I arrive late or early, if you see me, do it well! And treat me and my dog ​​well, especially since you know what we like and don't like, and what bothers her and me! And no, they should attend to us, but at the same time, "punish" us for being late, and not just that day, but for having been late the day before, that's just not right!!! If they want to serve us late, then they shouldn't and should change the appointment, but the mistreatment and making the dog look bad, or telling me that I'm making up the day and time, "like calling me a liar or crazy," well, that's unacceptable... and it's a shame because Berta adores her... Seriously, what a load of rubbish! As if I were late to the party, trying to cause harm, as if it were something personal. To think like that, you really have to have a twisted mind and a heart with zero empathy. I'm fed up with certain employees throughout El Corte Inglés in general (because customer service is a real joke, what they used to do there!), who think the store belongs to them....
Delighted with the service and the treatment. 100% recommended.
Bubu and I couldn't be happier! The service was a 10/10! They were absolutely delightful, and most importantly, their work was excellent. We'll definitely be back. 😍😍😍 …
It's a place I love; I have two huskies and they make them look gorgeous, plus they really enjoy going for a swim, and the service is excellent 👌 …

Highly recommended. This morning I took Boris, my British Longhair cat, for the first time. The experience was excellent. The women who cut his hair did a perfect job, despite the difficulty caused by the knots. Quick and super professional service. I will definitely be back.
Excellent service. Very friendly.

The dog was in heat (I told them) and her vulva was dilated. It looked like she was hurt during the shaving; she couldn't sit down because her vulva was red and sore, so I took her to the vet. She had to get a cortisone injection, chlorhexidine, and moisturizing cream.
You won't see me again.

100% recommended! We've returned because of the care and kindness with which they treat our dog. They make her look gorgeous, the spa is incredibly relaxing, and she doesn't react badly to the bath. Thank you!
Thank you for your feedback.
Excellent service and attention to my kitten. The care and dedication were very professional. I highly recommend them and we will definitely return.

Wonderful grooming salon, they took great care of the kitten and were very attentive. Everything was very clean, which is also important.
Thank you for your attention, we will definitely be back.
Perfect as always
I took my long-haired cat to get his fur cut. Both he and I were very happy with the service and the treatment. I'll definitely be back as soon as his fur grows back. Thanks from Taiga!

I took my long-haired, matted cat, whose fur is very difficult to brush and cut because he won't let you. He doesn't like it at all.
How lucky I was to have found this grooming salon.
They didn't sedate him, nor did he suffer any stress at all.
It's clear they treated him with great care, because Antxon left the salon incredibly happy and content.
Definitely a grooming salon I'd love to return to. Thank you so much for your work and dedication.
Everything was perfect!!! They're great and they make my feline friends look absolutely gorgeous!! Thank you
I loved how Renzo treated my Schnauzer. Both Dirce and Renzo treated her wonderfully. She seemed very comfortable with them. I'm very satisfied with the experience.
The groomers were excellent, did a great job, and my pet felt very comfortable with them. Renzo and Teresa did a fantastic job.
Delighted with the professional and friendly service they provide to me and my little Pekingese...we go every month to get him groomed...highly recommended.
Disappointing first visit. Not recommended if your dog is long-haired, large, and has any mats. There are much better professionals.
Impeccable service. Highly recommended.

I took my cat Nica to that groomer for the first time. It was the first time I'd shaved her, as I'd never taken her to a groomer before. I was a little nervous, but they explained the process and the aftercare. They were incredibly friendly and helpful. My cat is doing better than ever!

We were very happy with the service. We took my cat for a haircut (he's terrified of both baths and haircuts) and we had no problems at all. The cat loved the spa and they gave him a great haircut. You can tell they love animals; they're very careful, affectionate, and professional. We'll be back!
The hairdressing assistant who served us was unprofessional; we will not be returning.
On the last disastrous day, they cut way too much, and I think they even used WHAT I FORBID: THE MACHINE. Oh well, that's how they'll end up closing. Or losing their jobs.
The service was absolutely exquisite. You can tell they love dogs. We'll be back.

I wanted to write this review because the entire team deserves recognition for the work they do with our pets, and in my case, specifically with my dog.
They are careful and incredibly affectionate with him, caring for and pampering him as if he were their own pet, which makes my dog ​​feel comfortable and calm.
He is cared for by Teresa, a brunette with short black hair. If you're ever in the area, don't hesitate to leave your pet in her hands; she's a lovely and incredibly friendly person. I 100% recommend this grooming salon and its staff.

I have a little dog who is the love of my life, and I always want the best for him. Here, the whole team treated him impeccably with so much love, especially a short-haired, brunette employee, Teresa I think. Everyone was excellent with him and with me, not to mention how handsome and clean they made him look. I'll definitely be back. It's one of the best dog groomers I've ever been to because of the loving care they give the animals. Thank you so much!
In general they leave the dog looking perfect, but there is an assistant (a girl with short black hair) who is very rude and impertinent, because of her I will not return.

Delighted with the service, the attention, and the discovery. Dirce treated us wonderfully; she's a true professional, and the proof is in how calm and comfortable my little one was with her. Very grateful and already recommending them to everyone. I wish you all the best, team!
Excellent professionals. Dalle loves going. Wonderful!!!!
I took my dog, a toy poodle, to get her hair cut and bathed, and they did a great job. I highly recommend them; they were very kind and treated her wonderfully.
My Samoyed had a bad experience at another groomer, but Renzo's hands made him look amazing! You can see the quality and passion he has for his work. My dog ​​Quio and I are incredibly grateful.
They're the best. Miranda is so calm every time she stays for a bath, and it's such a relief for us to know they bathe her with care and love. We definitely recommend them!

My dog ​​Suri received spectacular treatment from Renzo and Teresa. They treated her wonderfully and made her look amazing.
Thank you for everything, we'll be back.
Excellent service, as always!

We took our dog Yayi to a full spa treatment. They pampered her, giving her a massage in the bubble jacuzzi, a superb bath, and a haircut. Renzo's service was impeccable; he made her look gorgeous. It was the best dog grooming experience we've ever had. I 100% recommend it for the service, the care, and the final result. Our dog left super happy, and we were even happier! I'm giving it 5 stars because I can't give it 10! Thank you!! ❤️
Delighted!!! My princess looks gorgeous every time she comes. Thank you so much for treating her so well and making her look beautiful! 😍 …
Everything was great, the staff was amazing, thank you for everything.
Fantastic!!
Great service and attention from Teresa, highly recommended.
The CIA was super good. Renzo bathed them and cut their hair and my little ones came out super happy 😊 …

I've been taking my two West Highland White Terriers to the salon at El Corte Inglés on Castellana ever since they opened, and I'm really happy. Not only with the quality of their haircuts, but also with the way they treat both the dogs and me.

They always take such good care of us, and Zeus loves his bath even though he's not very aquatic! They're kind, attentive, and incredibly affectionate with our furry friends. Absolutely top-notch professionals!
Mako always looks gorgeous, has a great time, and loves Renzo!!!!
I always bring Zoe to this salon 🥰 They treat her wonderfully and it turns out perfectly! Thank you so much for everything. …
Fantastic! They made him look beautiful and he left extremely happy. They treated him wonderfully. We'll definitely be back.

I took my dog ​​Evo, a white Swiss Shepherd, to the groomer.

It's the first time I've taken him to this groomer, and he came out very happy and super clean.
I'm very pleased with the service and will be back again in two months.
Very happy with the service and my dog's haircut. I'll be back!
